system.description:
Beginning at 9th level, you can concentrate on up to 3 Jutsu that would allow you to Teleport or grant you a bonus to Movement speed.

Also, as a Bonus action, you can spend 1 superiority die, to cast a jutsu you that would allow you to Teleport or grant you a bonus to movement speed as a bonus action, if it has a casting time of 1 Action.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.
